bin_boundary: right-closed; loss <= -3%, non-positive net (-3%, 0.3%], gain (0.3%, 3%], strong gain >3%
policy_selection: Policy-calibration only. Nine pre-fixed policies x two bounds, Bonferroni alpha 0.05/18; require block lower bounds, minimum samples and positive all-date net proxy lower bound. Choose highest lower net bound, deterministic ties. If none pass, abstain. Never retune on external scores.
evaluation_role: Already inspected historical development dates; not independent final validation
unavailable_period_behavior: Required primary period must have complete outcome dates; optional diagnostic periods without complete dates are reported unavailable, never filled or recomputed after dropping individual stocks
